teach.heading: Every candle has body parts.
teach.body: The candle body shows the distance between the open and close. The wick shows where price traveled but did not fully hold. The high and low show the full range of that candle. A wick does not automatically mean reversal — it means price reached that area and did not close there. Context tells you what that rejection means.
teach.dayliNote: "A wick shows me where price went. A close shows me where price accepted. That difference matters." — Dayli Scott

experience.prompt: Label a candle's parts: open, high, low, close, body, and wick. Which part tells you where price actually accepted?

reinforce.question: Tap the wick — the part of the candle that traveled but did not hold into the close.
Price wicks above resistance but closes below it — that means it reached above but did not ___ above.
